These are hand-built fixtures, not real pipeline output — real NISAR acquisition (P1.1/P1.2) is still blocked
pending Earthdata Login credentials (see docs/BLOCKERS.md). They are schema-complete (every field in
schemas/*.json is populated) so they exercise the full frontend data-loading and rendering path, but every
value in them is invented and must never be treated as, or shipped as, a real result. They are referenced only
from web/tests/fixtures and web/public/data/v1/dummy — `web/public/data/v1/reaches.json` intentionally does not
list this reach, so the deployed app shows the Section 21.1 Empty state until a real bundle is generated by
`make reproduce`.
